title: Mapping-space excision over a simplicial pushout along a monomorphism
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, products, Kan complexes, weak homotopy equivalences and internal functor simplicial sets of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and right fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $i:A\hookrightarrow B$ be a degreewise monomorphism of small simplicial sets, let $f:A\to C$ be any simplicial map, and let $P=B\amalg_A C$ be their pushout in simplicial sets. Let $p:X\to P$ be any simplicial map and let $q:Y\to P$ be a right fibration. For $T\in\{A,B,C\}$ put $X_T=X\times_P T$ and $Y_T=Y\times_P T$. For maps $Z\to T$ and $W\to T$, define $M_T(Z,W)_n=\{Z\times\Delta^n\to W\text{ over }T\}$, with simplex operators by precomposition.

The canonical map $X_B\amalg_{X_A}X_C\to X$ is a simplicial isomorphism, and restriction is a simplicial isomorphism
$$M_P(X,Y)\xrightarrow{\cong}M_B(X_B,Y_B)\times_{M_A(X_A,Y_A)}M_C(X_C,Y_C).$$
All four mapping complexes are Kan and the restriction $M_B(X_B,Y_B)\to M_A(X_A,Y_A)$ is a Kan fibration. In particular the restriction map from $M_P(X,Y)$ to the path model of this pullback is a weak homotopy equivalence. Explicitly this path model is
$$M_B(X_B,Y_B)\times_{M_A(X_A,Y_A),\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,M_A(X_A,Y_A))\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,M_A(X_A,Y_A)}M_C(X_C,Y_C),$$
and the map inserts the constant path at the common restriction. Thus the restriction square of mapping complexes is homotopy Cartesian, with the homotopy pullback interpreted by [lem-coef-kan-pullback-path-comparison]. Neither $p$ nor the bases are assumed fibrant, $f$ need not be injective, and no slice model structure is assumed.
